worldcombat.skill.acid.summary: Lobs a glob of harsh acid whose arc is solved to the aim point: a living target it strikes takes one hit at once. If the impact reaches a real collidable surface, the acid spreads over the landing point, splashes every reachable enemy around it and leaves a corrosive pool that keeps biting anyone who stays. It can also be aimed at an empty point with no enemy selected; a landing that is airborne or only flowers/liquid scatters without leaving a pool. On hit it may lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.0: Splash everyone around a landing spot at close range
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.1: Leave a lingering pool to lock down a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.2: Wear down Sp. Def with the cheapest cast
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.0: The living target the glob strikes directly takes one hit for about %1$s special damage (an airborne hit counts too); once it lands on a real support, every reachable enemy around the landing spot takes the same hit as well.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.1: The acid spreads over %1$s blocks around the landing spot and does not reach through walls; support is the nearest collidable surface below the impact, side hits step along the outward normal to the wall foot, and non-colliding surfaces like flowers and liquid do not count. With no support (airborne) it only scatters without leaving a pool.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.2: The pool left on the ground deals %1$s damage to every enemy inside it, lasting %2$s and biting once every %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.3: Each enemy splashed has a %1$s chance to have its Sp. Def lowered by %2$s stage(s), so it takes more special damage afterwards.
worldcombat.skill.acid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.acid.growth.0: From level %1$s the splash rises to %2$s power and the pool to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.corrod: On: pool radius ×1.25, duration +30 ticks, +1 tick wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown, but the burst ×0.85 — good for locking ground down. Off: a harder burst and a smaller pool for hurting a group.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it open with acid from further away.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.ai.cro: On: when the target stands on reachable ground, is not already covered by a pool, and other enemies stand within the real splash radius, it prefers acid; airborne targets stay selectable but score only the direct hit. Off: it sorts like an ordinary close-range attack.
worldcombat.skill.acid.corrode.note: With corrode on, the pool spreads wider and lasts longer, but the burst is lighter; with it off the burst hits harder and the pool is smaller.
